resources.string: A faster, brighter reading hub built around your sources, library and discoveries.
Keep manga and future novel sources in the same visual system without changing how repositories are added.
Novel-ready mode is separated from image reading so text chapters can use a dedicated comfortable reader while sharing the same repository discovery layer.
Your existing repository workflow stays intact. Sources remain managed from Browse, while Manga Heroes changes the experience around them.
Set a name for your local profile
Choose favorite genres to personalize discovery
Optional goals — your library and reader always remain available.
Use folders and CBZ/ZIP or image files as a private local source.

1. Create or choose a folder in device storage, then add it from Browse → Local source.
2. Put each series in its own folder; place chapter images in reading order, or store a chapter as CBZ/ZIP.
3. Keep supported image files (JPG, PNG, WEBP and formats supported by Android) together inside the chapter folder/archive.
4. In Local source, refresh the folder to discover added or changed files. Open a series to inspect chapters and read them like online content.
5. Back up the app database using Settings → Data and storage. Removing a local source does not delete the files in the device folder.
